implementation.classification: real cause-based E2E readiness precondition candidate; B33 response diagnostic retained
implementation.details: The test now waits for the matching repository's existing availability=ready and content_complete=true API state before deleting the container. It no longer performs a pre-removal canonical content GET. Container removal, backend restart/ensureReady, post-restart HTTP success, and INITIAL_CONTENT verification remain. The poll timeout is 60 seconds, unchanged from the removed content poll's 60-second timeout.
implementation.diagnostic: Post-restart failures now report HTTP status and up to 1000 response-body characters.

sourceBasis: Terminal summary and file metadata can precede content preservation. Repository content_complete is exposed by the existing history API and is set by preservation/export completion. Canonical content GET is not a completion signal; it acquires/releases a persisted retention lease and can render from Git without exporting/caching a payload.
limitations: No tests were run under the explicit no-heavy-resources constraint; git diff --check passed.
G10 retry-0 status/body remains unavailable, so its exact failure cause is unconfirmed.
The readiness DTO does not expose content_source. A post-restart failure after content_complete=true would indicate a source-lifetime/durability defect requiring production-level diagnosis.
next: Parent review, then run retries-disabled Docker regression after C12 is quiescent and use the newly surfaced HTTP evidence if failure persists.
